note_en: 不但没有 A，反而 B means "not only didn't A, but on the contrary B": 导游不但没有抱怨，反而很开心地带我们去了一家本地人才知道的小店 "far from complaining, the guide happily took us to a little shop only locals knew about." With 不但 learners expect 而且 ("and moreover"), but 反而 flips to an unexpected opposite outcome; English often uses "far from... , he..." or "instead" here.
